# Corner at y=466, x=227.5 is the front-most bottom corner of the cabinet facing the camera!
# Let us calculate its position:
import numpy as np

# Camera pose at obs 39:
cam_x = 0.7071
cam_y = 4.7071
theta = np.deg2rad(45)

d_front = 396.8 / (466.5 - 255.5)
xc_front = (227.5 - 255.5) / 256.0 * d_front

world_x_front = cam_x + d_front * np.sin(theta) + xc_front * np.cos(theta)
world_y_front = cam_y + d_front * np.cos(theta) - xc_front * np.sin(theta)

print(f"Front corner: d={d_front:.3f}, x={world_x_front:.3f}, y={world_y_front:.3f}")
'
